notes: CLI route: scripts/bugsee-sourcemaps.mjs runs bugsee-cli to inject debug ids into the built output and upload its source maps. The output directory is the argument, else BUGSEE_SOURCEMAPS_DIR, else tsconfig.json outDir or ./dist (whichever exists; the most recently built if both do); the app token comes from BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN or .env.bugsee-build-plugin. The rspack plugin does not upload yet (JS issue #184), so this recipe uses the bugsee-cli script until it lands. Enable devtool: "source-map" in the rspack config.
